description: Diagnostic for an S7 connection between two devices: available interfaces, nodes, and creationinfos. Requires a connected project. Maps to GET /connections/diagnose?localDevice=&partnerDevice= (both required). Read-only (class R).

localDevice.description: local device station name from tia_devices.name or tia_plcs.device, not the PLC software name (required)

partnerDevice.description: partner device station name from tia_devices.name or tia_plcs.device, not the PLC software name (required)

name: tia_connections_diagnose
title: TIA — S7 connection diagnostics
